Especially Dr Boyd. This has been the best GP I have ever had by a country mile!

I have struggled with my mental health since I was 15 years old and have always found it difficult going to the doctor's for help due to being dismissed and left out in the cold. Dr Boyd and the whole team at the Shawlands surgery have been unbelievably helpful, kind and caring.

It took 3 years to get my ADHD diagnosis since moving to Glasgow by no fault of the surgery (the waiting list is insane). I couldn't have hung on as long as I have if it wasn't for them all. I am the healthiest and happiest I have been in my entire adult life thanks to you all. Because of this I am finally getting my weight under control too which I had given up on a long time ago. I have lost 16kg due to their help and willingness to help me.

Thank you from the bottom of my
